note: Thursday A, workplace English（职场英语）: 事 si6 ×3, then Hard recall only (no new cards, no BBC today). Sets of 3–4, one-keyword cue, say each aloud before flipping, then a 3-beat run-through. Then one two-line work email and a 30–60 sec “I’ll take this and come back to you”. 加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (low, flat, no rise)

tasks.title: Input: read this two-line work email once (what is being asked? what are the next steps?)

lines.text: Hi Jia, could you clarify whether the visa checklist should cover all new hires or only overseas ones?
lines.translation: 想确认清单是覆盖所有新人还是只含海外员工。

lines.text: Once you confirm, please send the updated version to the team by Friday noon.
lines.translation: 你确认后，请在周五中午前把更新版发给团队。

tasks.prompt: Output 1, two lines aloud (or typed): reply to that email. Line 1 clarifies, line 2 gives next steps. Say it before opening the script.
tasks.script:
Hi, thanks for your message. Just to make sure I understand: should the checklist cover all new hires, or only overseas ones?
Once I have your answer, I will send the updated version to the team by Friday noon.

tasks.prompt: Output 2, 30–60 sec: “I’ll take this and come back to you.” Point → reason → example. Say it aloud before opening the script.
tasks.script:
Point: I’ll take this and come back to you by the end of the day.
Reason: I want to check the details first so my answer is accurate.
Example: So I will look at the checklist this afternoon and send you a short reply before 5 pm.

questions.explain: 事 si6 is low and flat. 低平调。

questions.q: “I’ll take this and come back to you” means…
options: I will handle it and reply later
questions.explain: 接下这件事，稍后回复你。

questions.q: “I want to flag early that this may slip to Thursday” means…
questions.explain: flag = 提前提醒；slip = 延期。

options: Just to make sure I understand — are you asking about the method, or the result?

questions.explain: 先说重点，再讲原因，最后举例。
